What is the Average Order Value?
It is the average monetary value spent by each customer in a single transaction. Indicates whether the
Customers are buying just the basics or adding extras.
Where to see and how to calculate?
Where to see: Shopify Sales Reports. Google Analytics 4 (1st - Reports; 2nd -
Monetization; 3rd - Overview; 4th - Make the calculation: Total Revenue ÷ Total Purchases).

3. Premium Services: Offer the option of "Extended Warranty" or "Engraving
Personalized" at checkout as a paid add-on.
